How to use this simulator

Change the room. Watch it respond. Explain your evidence.

Follow your workbook

  1. Sense. Change light, temperature, humidity or motion. Read the values before predicting what will happen.
  2. Connect. Choose REMOTE, open the remote commands and try a simulated Wi-Fi or Bluetooth command.
  3. Control. Press the LOCAL button to take control and toggle the room light. Compare what happens in each mode.
  4. Automate. Select AUTO. Try Shade, Warm and Motion. Watch the light, fan, door and status display, then read the decision history.

Try the energy challenge

Train and test the simulated decision tree, rehearse a gesture without using a camera, then compare two lighting rules across the same six scenes. Record both simulated light ON-time and useful lighting.

All room readings and commands run in your browser. Simulated light ON-time does not measure electricity use.
